categories.main_business_segments: Zhejiang Jinsheng New Materials Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of cosmetic plastic packaging containers. Its main product lines include cream jars and lotion bottles made from materials such as PMMA (acrylic), PP, ABS, PETG, and AS. The company also produces glass bottles and molds, serving high-end cosmetic brands domestically and internationally.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced injection molding, silk screen printing, hot stamping, coating, and assembly technologies. It has mastered precision mold processing, multi-cavity mold technology, and high-durability mold manufacturing. The production process integrates design, mold making, injection molding, printing, stamping, coating, and assembly, supported by automated equipment and intelligent logistics systems like SAP, MES, WCS, and CRM for digitalized production management.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are well-known domestic and international cosmetic brands such as Estée Lauder, OSM, Shanghai Jahwa, and others. The company serves the cosmetic industry, providing packaging solutions for skincare, makeup, and personal care products. Its markets include both domestic sales directly to cosmetic companies and international sales through professional supply chain management firms.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China, with its headquarters and main production facilities located in Shaoxing, Zhejiang Province, within the economically developed Yangtze River Delta region. It also exports products internationally, with foreign sales accounting for about 29.33% of total revenue, mainly settled in US dollars.
categories.supply_chain_position: Zhejiang Jinsheng New Materials operates in the midstream segment of the cosmetic packaging supply chain, focusing on manufacturing plastic and glass packaging containers. It procures raw plastic materials from upstream suppliers and delivers finished packaging products downstream to cosmetic brand manufacturers and supply chain companies.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes innovation in product design, mold development, and injection molding technology, aiming to enhance product quality and diversify product offerings. It invests in R&D for new materials, functional packaging (e.g., dual-chamber vacuum bottles), and sustainable materials like recyclable PP and PET. The firm also focuses on digital transformation and automation to improve efficiency and reduce costs.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of cosmetic packaging products, including injection molded plastic parts, glass bottles, and molds. The company operates mainly on a direct sales model, with some sales through distributors. Revenue recognition occurs upon product delivery and customer acceptance.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The cosmetic plastic packaging industry is highly competitive with many small and medium-sized players. Zhejiang Jinsheng New Materials is positioned as a mid-to-high-end supplier with strong technical capabilities, a broad product range, and stable relationships with leading cosmetic brands. It benefits from scale, quality management, and geographic advantages compared to overseas competitors.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 333 million, a 28.15% increase year-over-year, with a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 22.65 million, slightly improved from the previous year. The company has total assets of around RMB 732 million and net assets of RMB 599 million. It is in a growth phase, expanding production capacity and investing in automation projects.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates itself through high-quality, aesthetically pleasing packaging solutions using premium materials like PMMA acrylic, which offers glass-like transparency and durability. It provides customized design and integrated services from mold design to final assembly, supported by advanced manufacturing technology and digitalized production. Its strong customer base among top cosmetic brands and continuous innovation in product functionality and sustainability enhance its competitive edge.
